text: Emit a replay capsule next to every repair: exact input bytes, working directory, bounded command, and raw exit transcript.

A paper-airplane receipt folds differently for each proof, so a parent can see the whole test trip in one shape.
A magic mailbox spits out a red marble only when two workers tell the same story about a repair.
A puzzle lock has four teeth for route, custody, testing, and acceptance; the finished box cannot close with a missing tooth.
